annotations.central_issue: The final claim conflates in-sample fit with robustness: fitting observed cases does not license treating omitted factors as 'irrelevant by definition,' because omitted factors may have been constant or unexpressed in the observed cases and could dominate outside that range.
annotations.why_it_matters: This closing inference contradicts the argument's own stated standard (stress-testing against reintroduced factors, boundary cases, and perturbations). If accepted, it collapses the robustness criterion into a mere goodness-of-fit criterion, licensing exactly the failure mode the argument warns against: simplifications that break when omitted structure varies out of sample. The body of the argument survives; the final universal license does not.
explicit_concessions: Every model is selective; full realism is impossible
Complexity is not evidence of fidelity
A simplification fails when omitted factors change orderings or create qualitatively new behavior
acceptable_secondary: Observed cases may not exercise the omitted factor at all (restricted range, collinearity, or held-constant conditions), so fit is silent about it
Multiple distinct models can fit the same observations (underdetermination), so fit alone cannot certify which structure is dispensable
tempting_but_weak: Demanding a precise operational definition of 'plausible omitted factors' or 'relevant omitted structure' — the standard is purpose-relative and workable without full operationalization
Objecting that the burden-of-proof framing is vague or that stress-testing is costly — these are implementation concerns, not defects of the criterion
Attacking the claim that simple models can capture dominant mechanisms — this is a well-supported, bounded claim
non_novel_restatements: Repeating that all models omit details and that omission alone is not a flaw — the argument already concedes this
Noting that simplifications can fail when omitted factors interact with results — the argument states this explicitly
minimum_full_credit_elements: Identify the final sentence as the flawed step: fit to observed cases does not make omitted factors irrelevant 'by definition'
Explain why: omitted factors may not have varied in the observed cases, so past fit cannot rule out their relevance under new conditions
Note the internal tension: this claim contradicts the argument's own robustness/stress-testing standard
State the salvageable restriction: observed fit supports irrelevance only across the conditions actually observed, not across the model's intended range of use

annotations.central_issue: The final paragraph introduces a circularity that undermines the entire robustness framework: it treats fit to observed cases as definitional proof of irrelevance, thereby making the very stress-testing the argument mandates logically impossible.
annotations.why_it_matters: The final paragraph converts an empirical, falsifiable robustness standard into an unfalsifiable definitional one, so the central conclusion—that the burden is to show robustness to relevant omitted structure—self-destructs.
explicit_concessions: Every model is selective; full realism is not the correct standard.
Complexity is not evidence of fidelity.
A simple model can produce reliable insight even at low descriptive realism.
acceptable_secondary: The argument does not specify how to operationalize 'plausible omitted factors,' leaving robustness testing somewhat underspecified.
The distinction between tractability assumptions and world-claims is asserted but not operationalized.
tempting_but_weak: Arguing the argument is incomplete because it lacks examples—incompleteness is not a fatal flaw here.
Objecting that 'dominant mechanism' is vague—this is a bounded limitation, not a central failure.
Claiming the argument conflates explanation with prediction—it does not; both are addressed.
non_novel_restatements: Saying the last paragraph 'overgeneralizes'—this merely relabels the circularity without identifying the logical structure of the problem.
minimum_full_credit_elements: Identifying the circularity specifically in the final paragraph, not a general charge of vagueness.
Showing that the circularity contradicts the robustness criteria established earlier in the same argument.
Explaining why this makes the stated conditions for failure unworkable.
